// Precompute factorials and inverse factorials

$fact = array_fill(0, $maxN + 1, 1);
$invFact = array_fill(0, $maxN + 1, 1);

for ($i = 1; $i <= $maxN; $i++) {
    $fact[$i] = ($fact[$i - 1] * $i) % MOD;
}

function modPow($a, $e) {
    $res = 1;
    $a %= MOD;
    while ($e > 0) {
        if ($e & 1) $res = ($res * $a) % MOD;
        $a = ($a * $a) % MOD;
        $e >>= 1;
    }
    return $res;
}

$invFact[$maxN] = modPow($fact[$maxN], MOD - 2);
for ($i = $maxN; $i > 0; $i--) {
    $invFact[$i - 1] = ($invFact[$i] * $i) % MOD;
}

function C($n, $r, $fact, $invFact) {
    if ($r < 0 || $r > $n) return 0;
    return (($fact[$n] * $invFact[$r]) % MOD * $invFact[$n - $r]) % MOD;
}

// DP for number of permutations of size m with max at last position
// and no run of length k of non-increasing elements ending before last.
$dp = array_fill(0, $n + 1, 0);
$pref = array_fill(0, $n + 1, 0);
$dp[0] = 1;
$pref[0] = 1;

for ($m = 1; $m <= $n; $m++) {
    if ($m < $k) {
        // All permutations valid
        $dp[$m] = $fact[$m - 1];
    } else {
        // dp[m] = sum_{i=0}^{m-k} dp[i] * (m-1-i)!
        $sum = 0;
        // We can maintain prefix sums of dp[i] * (m-1-i)! is too heavy.
        // Instead, use recurrence:
        // Let f[m] = dp[m] / (m-1)!; then derive:
        // dp[m] = (m-1)! * (prefF[m-k] - prefF[-1]) where prefF is prefix of f.
        // Implement directly with O(n) using f and prefix of f.
        // To keep code simple and efficient, precompute f and its prefix.
        // But we are inside loop; restructure outside.
        // Break and recompute with new approach.
        $dp = $dp; // placeholder to avoid syntax error
    }
}

// Recompute with better method
$dp = array_fill(0, $n + 1, 0);
$f = array_fill(0, $n + 1, 0);
$prefF = array_fill(0, $n + 1, 0);

$dp[0] = 1;
$f[0] = 1; // dp[0]/(-1)! treated as 1
$prefF[0] = 1;

for ($m = 1; $m <= $n; $m++) {
    if ($m < $k) {
        $dp[$m] = $fact[$m - 1];
        $f[$m] = ($dp[$m] * modPow($fact[$m - 1], MOD - 2)) % MOD; // =1
    } else {
        // dp[m] = (m-1)! * sum_{i=0}^{m-k} f[i]
        $sumF = $prefF[$m - $k];
        $dp[$m] = ($fact[$m - 1] * $sumF) % MOD;
        $f[$m] = ($dp[$m] * modPow($fact[$m - 1], MOD - 2)) % MOD;
    }
    $prefF[$m] = ($prefF[$m - 1] + $f[$m]) % MOD;
}

$good = 0;

    $ways = (C($n - 1, $m - 1, $fact, $invFact) * $dp[$m]) % MOD;

}

$bad = ($total - $good) % MOD;
if ($bad < 0) $bad += MOD;

echo $bad . PHP_EOL;
?>

<?php
// Constants
const MOD = 1000000007;

// Fast input
list($n, $k) = array_map('intval', explode(' ', trim(fgets(STDIN))));

// Precompute factorials and inverse factorials
$maxN = $n;
$fact = array_fill(0, $maxN + 1, 1);
$invFact = array_fill(0, $maxN + 1, 1);

for ($i = 1; $i <= $maxN; $i++) {
    $fact[$i] = ($fact[$i - 1] * $i) % MOD;
}

// Fast power
function modPow($a, $e) {
    $res = 1;
    $a %= MOD;
    while ($e > 0) {
        if ($e & 1) $res = ($res * $a) % MOD;
        $a = ($a * $a) % MOD;
        $e >>= 1;
    }
    return $res;
}

// Inverse factorials
$invFact[$maxN] = modPow($fact[$maxN], MOD - 2);
for ($i = $maxN; $i > 0; $i--) {
    $invFact[$i - 1] = ($invFact[$i] * $i) % MOD;
}

function C($n, $k, $fact, $invFact) {
    if ($k < 0 || $k > $n) return 0;
    return (($fact[$n] * $invFact[$k]) % MOD * $invFact[$n - $k]) % MOD;
}

// If k >= n, function always returns n, so answer is 0
if ($k >= $n) {
    echo "0\n";
    exit;
}

// Compute number of permutations where function returns n
// Using combinatorial formula derived from problem analysis
$ansGood = 0;
$maxT = $n - $k; // t = position of n, must satisfy t + k <= n

for ($t = 1; $t <= $maxT; $t++) {
    $len = $t + $k; // prefix length
    // Count permutations where maximum in first len positions is at position t
    // and no element > n appears later (always true since it's permutation)
    // Number of ways:
    // choose t-1 elements from [1..n-1] to be before n, and arrange them
    // choose k elements from remaining [1..n-1-(t-1)] to be after n in prefix, and arrange them
    // arrange remaining n - (t + k) elements after prefix
    $before = $t - 1;
    $afterPrefix = $k;
    if ($before < 0 || $afterPrefix < 0) continue;
    if ($before + $afterPrefix > $n - 1) continue;

    $waysChooseBefore = C($n - 1, $before, $fact, $invFact);
    $waysArrangeBefore = $fact[$before];

    $remaining = $n - 1 - $before;
    $waysChooseAfterPrefix = C($remaining, $afterPrefix, $fact, $invFact);
    $waysArrangeAfterPrefix = $fact[$afterPrefix];

    $remainingAfter = $n - ($t + $k);
    if ($remainingAfter < 0) continue;
    $waysArrangeRest = $fact[$remainingAfter];

    $ways = $waysChooseBefore;
    $ways = ($ways * $waysArrangeBefore) % MOD;
    $ways = ($ways * $waysChooseAfterPrefix) % MOD;
    $ways = ($ways * $waysArrangeAfterPrefix) % MOD;
    $ways = ($ways * $waysArrangeRest) % MOD;

    $ansGood = ($ansGood + $ways) % MOD;
}

// Total permutations
$total = $fact[$n];
// Bad permutations = total - good
$ansBad = ($total - $ansGood) % MOD;
if ($ansBad < 0) $ansBad += MOD;

echo $ansBad . "\n";

// Fast IO
list($n, $k) = array_map('intval', explode(' ', trim(fgets(STDIN))));
$MOD = 1000000007;

$maxNK = max($n, $k);

// Precompute factorials and inverse factorials up to n
$fact = array_fill(0, $n + 1, 1);
$invFact = array_fill(0, $n + 1, 1);

for ($i = 1; $i <= $n; $i++) {
    $fact[$i] = ($fact[$i - 1] * $i) % $MOD;
}

// fast power
function modPow($a, $e, $mod) {
    $res = 1;
    while ($e > 0) {
        if ($e & 1) $res = ($res * $a) % $mod;
        $a = ($a * $a) % $mod;
        $e >>= 1;
    }
    return $res;
}

$invFact[$n] = modPow($fact[$n], $MOD - 2, $MOD);
for ($i = $n; $i > 0; $i--) {
    $invFact[$i - 1] = ($invFact[$i] * $i) % $MOD;
}

function C($n, $r, $fact, $invFact, $MOD) {
    if ($r < 0 || $r > $n) return 0;
    return (($fact[$n] * $invFact[$r]) % $MOD * $invFact[$n - $r]) % $MOD;
}

// Precompute factorials up to k for derangements
$factK = array_fill(0, $k + 1, 1);
for ($i = 1; $i <= $k; $i++) {
    $factK[$i] = ($factK[$i - 1] * $i) % $MOD;
}

// Precompute derangements D[0..k]
$D = array_fill(0, $k + 1, 0);
$D[0] = 1;
if ($k >= 1) $D[1] = 0;
for ($i = 2; $i <= $k; $i++) {
    $D[$i] = (($i - 1) * (($D[$i - 1] + $D[$i - 2]) % $MOD)) % $MOD;
}

// Precompute S[t] = sum_{j=0..t} C(t,j)*D[j] for t up to k
$S = array_fill(0, $k + 1, 0);
for ($t = 0; $t <= $k; $t++) {
    $sum = 0;
    for ($j = 0; $j <= $t; $j++) {
        $sum = ($sum + C($t, $j, $fact, $invFact, $MOD) * $D[$j]) % $MOD;
    }
    $S[$t] = $sum;
}

// Compute answer
$ans = 0;
$limit = min($n, $k);
for ($t = 0; $t <= $limit; $t++) {
    $ways = ($S[$t] * $fact[$n - $t]) % $MOD;
    $ans = ($ans + $ways) % $MOD;
}

echo $ans . PHP_EOL;
?>
